notes: 72 examples, 3B not 7B, no inner-val. max_seq_len was 4096 and unvalidated; measured against the real tokenizer on 2026-09-08 and every one of the 72 examples exceeded it, the largest at 13276 tokens. Raised to 16384 -- about 3100 tokens of headroom, roughly a dozen more tools before it binds again. The full 54-tool catalog is the realistic inference condition and costs 8x the tokens of the 5-tool listen subset for the SAME 11654 assistant tokens, because the catalog is pure prompt; that cost is accepted deliberately, since a task made easy by shrinking the menu is what the experiment contract exists to prevent. per_device batch dropped 2 -> 1 with grad_accum 4 -> 8 so effective_batch stays 8: at 13k tokens the activation footprint binds, and 1x8 is the shape the v1 arc proved at this length.
